'''Chall-crystal''' was a material found in [[the galaxy]]. The interior of the [[Seltiss-2 caravel]] was decorated with chall-crystal, [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]], and [[Greel wood/Legends|greel wood]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
